scenes.text: The apartment below mine has been empty for a year.
scenes.art_prompt: the tenant below - scene 1, cinematic, anime-horror

scenes.text: Last night, someone moved furniture down there. Slowly. All night.
scenes.art_prompt: the tenant below - scene 2, cinematic, anime-horror

scenes.text: I knocked on the floor. The knocking came back - from under the floor.
scenes.art_prompt: the tenant below - scene 3, cinematic, anime-horror

scenes.text: I called the building manager. He checked the plans twice.
scenes.art_prompt: the tenant below - scene 4, cinematic, anime-horror

scenes.text:
There is no apartment below mine.
The building stops at my floor. It always has.
